numDeadTuples.description:
Number of dead tuples.  An excessive number relative to {@link numLiveTuples} may indicate that vacuuming is
recommended for the table.

vacuumCount.description: Number of times the table has been manually vacuumed.

lastVacuum.description: Last time the table was manually vacuumed.

autoVacuumCount.description: Number of times the table has been auto vacuumed.

lastAutoVacuum.description: Last time the table was auto vacuumed.

fragmentationPct.description: Fragmentation of data in the postgres table as a percentage number in the range [0, 100]
